caption: The video captures a close, eye-level view of a shallow rocky stream where a small cascade of white, aerated water tumbles over a low ledge at the center and feeds a clear, slow pool in the foreground. Smooth tan and brown stones lie submerged beneath the pool. Large moss-covered green boulders and gray rocks frame the upper edge, and a rounded tan rock rests at the right. The white froth of the cascade continuously reshapes as water pours over the ledge, its outline and internal bubble pattern shifting from moment to moment. Bubbles and bright specular flecks appear, drift, and pop across the mid-foreground surface. Ripples and surface texture change shape and position, indicating steady downstream flow toward the viewer. The submerged stones and background rocks remain fixed, keeping the overall layout constant.
